description: This file defines a service for aggregating hierarchical LLM (Large Language Model) costs, including functions for data projection, grouping, and formatting, as well as index management for the 'llm_costs' collection in MongoDB.

methods.name: projectionStage
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB aggregation projection stage to normalize and extract relevant fields from the raw data.

methods.name: addDateKeyStage
methods.description: Adds a date object to the documents based on various possible date fields.

methods.name: projectDateKeyStage
methods.description: Projects the normalized date as a string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format along with other fields.

methods.name: groupByAgentDateStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, project, agent, and date, summing costs and tokens per day.

methods.name: groupAgentTotalsStage
methods.description: Aggregates data by agent, summing total costs and preparing costs and tokens by date.

methods.name: agentProjectStage
methods.description: Projects agent-level data with total costs and costs/tokens by date.

methods.name: groupProjectStage
methods.description: Groups data by project, summing project costs and aggregating agents.

methods.name: projectProjectStage
methods.description: Projects project-level data with total costs and agent details.

methods.name: groupUserStage
methods.description: Groups data by user, summing total user costs and listing projects.

methods.name: finalProjectStage
methods.description: Projects the final user-level aggregate with total cost and project details.

methods.name: aggregateHierarchy
methods.description: Main function to perform the hierarchical aggregation of LLM costs from the database.

methods.name: ensureLlmCostsIndexes
methods.description: Creates indexes on the 'llm_costs' collection to optimize query performance.
